# CheckLinks 1.1.1

- Fewer false **Broken** results. A link whose HEAD request returns 404 is now confirmed with GET before it is reported, so servers that mishandle HEAD no longer produce false failures.
- Links on the same site as the scanned page that return 404 now appear as **May need sign-in** under **Other** instead of **Broken**. Checks still run signed out, and many sites (GitHub included) answer signed-out requests for account-only pages with 404.

Validation: 13 automated background regression tests passed, including new coverage for the HEAD-404 retry and same-site sign-in handling.

The extension keeps the same requested permissions, and link checks still omit credentials.
